method: GAAP total revenue taken from SEC EDGAR XBRL filings (tag RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax, except GOOGL annuals 2023-2025 which use the Revenues tag — identical values). Quarters disclosed only in the annual 10-K (fiscal Q4 for MSFT/Oracle; calendar Q4 for AMZN/GOOGL/Meta) were derived as 10-K annual revenue minus the three 10-Q quarterly values from the same fiscal year; these tie exactly to reported annuals. Cross-checked headline quarters against company IR earnings releases.
notes: Oracle series note: the FY26 Q1 10-Q (Jun-Aug 2025 quarter) filed 2025-09-10 gives Q3'25 = $14.926B and FY26 Q2 10-Q (Sep-Nov 2025) filed 2025-12-11 gives Q4'25 = $16.058B. In the raw XBRL the 2025-02-28 fact carries a 2026-03-11 filing date (re-reported in FY26 10-Q); values are identical to the original 10-Q.
MSFT Q2'26 uses the earnings-release figure $90.01B (XBRL derivation $90.007B; difference is rounding).
Oracle Q2'26 uses the XBRL-derived $19.183B; Oracle's Q4 FY2026 press release reported $19.2B (rounded).

AMZN.fiscal_mapping: December year-end: calendar quarters 1:1. Calendar Q4 values derived from each year's 10-K annual net sales minus Q1-Q3 10-Q values (Q4 is not tagged quarterly in EDGAR).

CRWV.fiscal_mapping: December year-end (public since March 2025 IPO): calendar quarters 1:1. Pre-2024 quarters: null (private company, no quarterly disclosure). Q4'24/Q4'25 derived from 10-K annual revenue minus Q1-Q3 10-Q values.
sources: Q1'22-Q4'23: null — CoreWeave was private; only annual figures exist (2023 annual $229.0M from 10-K 2025, accn 0001769628-26-000104, filed 2026-03-02)

Q1'24 $0.189B / Q2'24 $0.395B / Q3'24 $0.584B: comparative quarterly columns in CoreWeave's 2025 10-Q filings; 10-K 2025 (accn 0001769628-26-000104, filed 2026-03-02, 2024 annual $1.915B): Q4'24 derived $0.747B

GOOGL.fiscal_mapping: December year-end: calendar quarters 1:1. Calendar Q4 values derived from each year's 10-K annual revenues minus Q1-Q3 10-Q values (Q4 is not tagged quarterly in EDGAR).

MSFT.fiscal_mapping: June year-end. Fiscal Q1 (Jul-Sep) = calendar Q3 label; Fiscal Q2 (Oct-Dec) = calendar Q4 label; Fiscal Q3 (Jan-Mar) = calendar Q1 label; Fiscal Q4 (Apr-Jun) = calendar Q2 label. June-quarter (fiscal Q4) values are derived from each year's 10-K annual revenue minus the other three fiscal quarters (MSFT files no 10-Q for the June quarter).
sources: Microsoft Q4 FY2026 earnings release (2026-07-29): Q2'26 $90.01B; 10-K FY2026 (accn 0001193125-26-323660, filed 2026-07-29, annual $331.839B) confirms derivation $90.007B

Meta.fiscal_mapping: December year-end: calendar quarters 1:1. Calendar Q4 values derived from each year's 10-K annual revenue minus Q1-Q3 10-Q values (Q4 is not tagged quarterly in EDGAR).

Oracle.fiscal_mapping: May year-end. Fiscal Q1 (Jun-Aug) = calendar Q3 label of the SAME calendar year (e.g. FY23 Q1, Jun-Aug 2022, = Q3'22 label); Fiscal Q2 (Sep-Nov) = calendar Q4 label; Fiscal Q3 (Dec-Feb) = calendar Q1 label; Fiscal Q4 (Mar-May) = calendar Q2 label. Fiscal Q4 (May quarter) values are derived from each year's 10-K annual revenue minus the other three fiscal quarters (Oracle files no 10-Q for the May quarter).
sources: 10-K FY2026 (accn 0001193125-26-277521, filed 2026-06-22, annual $67.357B): Q2'26 (fiscal Q4, Mar-May 2026) derived $19.183B — matches Oracle Q4 FY2026 press release / 8-K (2026-06-10, reported $19.2B)
